status: implemented and verified in the branch worktree; not committed or published
changes: Default release repository is skydrow98/duoyi; historical distribution build arguments migrate to it while custom repositories and explicit empty values remain supported.
Official-channel update checks reject metadata from a different GitHub repository and isolate cached installers and background download tasks by source.
Native desktop focus duration uses a mouse/keyboard dropdown plus count-up toggle; running, paused and read-only states retain duration locks.
Focus header spans the page so the macOS floating-window entry stays at the right gutter.
Habit detail heatmap adapts its visible history from 20 to 104 weeks while trend statistics retain their chosen window.
Period details omit inactive days and buckets without active days, with a localized empty state.
Make-up calendar disables today and future dates and rechecks application date boundaries before writes; ordinary today check-in remains supported.
macOS todo filters collapse by default and wrap when expanded; the page has a route-aware back header and Escape handling, and the create action reads Add task.
